get.description: Only facts from filings filed on or before as_of. Optional filters combine with AND. Cursor pagination has stable total ordering by (accession_id, tag, taxonomy, period_end, duration_quarters, unit, segments, coreg).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Only filings filed on or before this date; no default. Datetime requires an explicit offset and normalizes to UTC milliseconds. Ordinary datetime filters accepted only. Attested date filters non-null filed <= as_of; attested datetime additionally requires non-null accepted <= as_of and filed <= UTC_DATE(as_of). Facts use submissions.filed; revisions use event-row filed and submissions.accepted.

parameters.name: cik
parameters.description: SEC Central Index Key, or a comma-separated set of at most 200 CIKs. Mutually exclusive with ticker.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Not served in v1: returns 501 not_implemented. Mutually exclusive with cik.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: As-filed XBRL element name. Mutually exclusive with concept_alias.

parameters.name: taxonomy
parameters.description: Taxonomy version qualifying tag, for example us-gaap/2024.

parameters.name: period_start
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the fact period end date.

parameters.name: period_end
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on the fact period end date.

parameters.name: duration_quarters
parameters.description: Period length: 0 instantaneous, 1 quarterly, 4 annual.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Unit of measure, for example USD, shares, or USD/shares.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: Filing form type, resolved by filing join.

parameters.name: concept_alias
parameters.description: Plain-language concept mapped to ordered as-filed tags. Mutually exclusive with tag; unknown aliases return 400 invalid_request. Adds matched_tag to each fact and concept to the response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum page size.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous response; do not parse or modify. Resend the same as_of.

parameters.name: attested
parameters.description: Opt-in signed cutoff. Requires as_of on every page; unknown or repeated parameters and mismatched cursors return 400 invalid_request.

get.description: Four fiscal quarters ending at the explicit fiscal_year and fiscal_quarter. Date as_of selects filed <= as_of; datetime as_of with an explicit offset selects accepted <= as_of. Fiscal periods require unique eligible filing metadata. Adjacent anchored period ends must be 2, 3 or 4 calendar months apart; the first and last of the four window ends, and the Q1 and Q4 ends of any fiscal year used to derive Q4, must be 8, 9 or 10 calendar months apart. Any other spacing is unavailable (422). Only 10-Q, 10-Q/A, 10-K and 10-K/A filings participate. Exact tag, taxonomy, unit, segments and coreg must agree. Omitted selectors must resolve to one series. Select the greatest (filed date, acceptance instant, accession) per period and duration; missing acceptance sorts first. Use discrete duration_quarters=1 facts, never cumulative YTD. Prefer reported Q4; otherwise subtract Q1, Q2 and Q3 from FY. Every quarter lists every contributing source, ordered FY then Q1 through Q3 for derived Q4. Identical inputs and source data produce byte-identical successful JSON. Malformed parameters return invalid_request; ambiguous selections return conflict; unavailable combinations return unprocessable. Scans exceeding 5000 eligible filings or 50000 matching facts return unprocessable, never a partial value.

parameters.description: One SEC Central Index Key.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Exact as-filed XBRL element name.

parameters.name: taxonomy
parameters.description: Exact taxonomy version; no cross-version mapping.

parameters.name: fiscal_year
parameters.description: Fiscal year of the ending quarter, as recorded in filing metadata.

parameters.name: fiscal_quarter
parameters.description: Ending fiscal quarter.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Required filing date or acceptance datetime with offset. Datetimes normalize to UTC milliseconds as on /v1/facts.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Exact unit; omit only when unambiguous.

parameters.name: segments
parameters.description: Exact stored dimension string; empty selects unsegmented facts. No dimension normalization.

parameters.name: coreg
parameters.description: Exact stored co-registrant string; empty selects the registrant.

200.description: One TTM value with complete per-quarter derivation.

get.summary: Ticker and CIK mappings as of a date
get.description: Supply exactly one of ticker or cik. Returns every mapping in effect on as_of (valid_from <= as_of < valid_to; a null valid_to is open), each with its exchange, validity window, source and point_in_time. A ticker that maps to several CIKs on the date returns every candidate; none is picked. Mapping history starts at the first security master snapshot, so an as_of before it returns an empty data array. Name-only records are not served. Results are ordered by (cik, ticker, company_name, valid_from, source); the cursor binds the filter and the effective as_of.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Ticker symbol: letters and digits with single internal dots or hyphens, case-insensitive; a hyphen is read as a dot. Mutually exclusive with cik; one of the two is required.

parameters.name: cik
parameters.description: SEC Central Index Key. Mutually exclusive with ticker; one of the two is required.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Date on which the mappings must be in effect. Defaults to the current UTC date; the response echoes the effective date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum page size.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous response; do not parse or modify. Resend the same as_of.

200.description: Success, including an empty data array when nothing matches.
